paper.title: DiM-WAM: World Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory
paper.title_cn: DiM-WAM：具有多样化历史事件记忆的世界—动作建模
paper.source_path: /Users/roywangj/journey_wj/research/papers4zotero/zotero1/storage/ZX4VLCU3/Wang 等 - 2026 - DIM-WAM World-Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory.pdf

blocks.original_text: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual states and actions... average full-task success rate from 52.5% to 90.0%.
blocks.translation: 世界—动作模型联合预测未来视觉状态和动作；DiM-WAM 以 DHEM 增强，并在训练匹配和真实任务上提升成功率。

blocks.original_text: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) learn robot policies by predicting actions... short local contexts alone.
blocks.translation: VLA 从语言和视觉预测动作；WAM 以未来视觉预测提供稠密监督，但短局部上下文仍限制长时程任务。

blocks.original_text: Consider the water-dispenser task in Fig. 1... key historical events and task-progress cues.
blocks.translation: 饮水机任务说明相似局部观测可能对应不同动作，须依赖历史事件和任务进度。

blocks.original_text: Long-horizon manipulation requires retaining different types of task-relevant events... complementary event patterns.
blocks.translation: 长时程操作需要保留多类任务相关事件，因此需要发现并保存互补事件模式的记忆机制。

blocks.original_text: Simply enlarging the local context increases computational cost... prediction and control.
blocks.translation: 扩大局部上下文成本高且会稀释关键事件；WAM 的视觉—动作监督可学习多样历史表征。

blocks.original_text: Inspired by the multiple memory subsystems (MMSS) view... 90.0% average full-task success rate.
blocks.translation: 受多记忆子系统启发，DiM-WAM 以多库 DHEM 选择、融合事件，并以进度监督促进任务阶段表征。

blocks.original_text: Prior WAMs use future visual prediction... observation-grounded long-term memory into WAMs.
blocks.translation: 现有 WAM 改善未来预测、视觉—动作耦合和效率，但未解决有界记忆的任务历史存取。

blocks.original_text: Memory-augmented VLAs incorporate historical information... joint prediction and control in WAMs.
blocks.translation: 记忆增强 VLA 使用多种设计纳入历史，但主要服务动作推理而非 WAM 联合预测与控制的记忆设计。

blocks.original_text: Long-video generation faces a related challenge... closed-loop control.
blocks.translation: 长视频记忆侧重视觉一致性；WAM 记忆还需编码进度、物体状态和动作后果。

blocks.original_text: As shown in Fig. 2(a), at decision segment i, DiM-WAM takes language instruction c... memory readout during training.
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 使用指令、局部 KV 上下文与持久记忆，记忆 token 条件化双去噪分支并被辅助进度目标监督。

blocks.original_text: For bookkeeping, we summarize the temporal evidence available to the model as Eq. (1).
blocks.translation: 式 (1) 汇总模型可利用的时间证据。

blocks.original_text: During inference, DiM-WAM predicts future visual latents and actions... past interactions and object-state changes.
blocks.translation: 推理时模型由指令、局部上下文和长期记忆预测未来潜变量与动作；长期记忆提供跨阶段证据。

blocks.original_text: Historical events in long-horizon tasks have different semantic roles... maintain complementary evidence.
blocks.translation: 异质且时间相邻的事件若共享一库会竞争且被破坏性混合，因此使用并行记忆库。

blocks.original_text: Before decision segment i, the long-term memory state of DHEM is denoted by Mi... total memory cost is O(KN).
blocks.translation: DHEM 含 K 个并行记忆库、每库 N 槽，每个事件存 token、时间、质量、有效性，总成本 O(KN)。

blocks.original_text: Bank roles are not predefined... bank identity embeddings mark token sources.
blocks.translation: 各库角色不预设；库特定查询、库内维护与多样性损失使其分化，读取时身份嵌入标识来源。

blocks.original_text: After extracting a bank-conditioned candidate event feature... redundancy-based compression.
blocks.translation: 每个库从当前观测提取候选事件后，独立进行新颖性感知保留和冗余压缩。

blocks.original_text: After segment i, the current observation... Each bank uses its learnable summary query qk to extract a candidate event feature.
blocks.translation: 当前观测被编码为视觉特征；每个库用可学习摘要查询提取候选事件。

blocks.original_text: Using shared query and key projections... not generated predictions.
blocks.translation: 共享投影产生 token 权重、注意力摘要和候选特征；持久记忆保存由观测导出的 token 而非生成预测。

blocks.original_text: In each bank, slot 1 is a fixed initial-state anchor... low relative novelty.
blocks.translation: 每库第 1 槽为锚点、第 N 槽为最新事件，中段保存压缩历史；高冗余优先级意味着低新颖性。

blocks.original_text: When a memory bank is full, only adjacent middle-history pairs are eligible... redundancy between the incoming candidate and the latest event is Eq. (9).
blocks.translation: 满库时只考虑相邻中段历史对；选择冗余最大的对，并计算新候选和最新事件的冗余。

blocks.original_text: The incoming candidate is therefore discarded when its redundancy... Otherwise, (p*,q*) is merged to make room for the candidate.
blocks.translation: 若新候选与最新事件的冗余不小于历史对最大冗余，则丢弃；否则合并所选历史对腾出空间。

blocks.original_text: The merged event preserves accumulated evidence through mass-weighted fusion... illustrated in Fig. 2(c).
blocks.translation: 融合以质量加权方式保存累积证据；质量加权时间戳可为非整数，合并压紧仍保持时间顺序。

blocks.original_text: Algorithm 1 summarizes one bank update... Memory cost is O(KN), independent of trajectory length.
blocks.translation: 算法 1 描述单库更新；初始化副本优先驱逐，锚点、最新事件和中段时间顺序在任一路径后保持。

blocks.original_text: After bank-local writing, valid event tokens are flattened... persistent memory is updated only from subsequent observations collected from the environment.
blocks.translation: 有效 token 以槽位优先、库次序展平，加入身份嵌入并由 RoPE 注入槽位相对时间；记忆只由后续环境观测更新。

blocks.original_text: As illustrated in Fig. 2(b), an auxiliary head predicts a coarse progress bin during training... normalized completion ratio is safely defined as Eq. (15).
blocks.translation: 训练辅助头预测粗进度分箱，让记忆编码轨迹进度；式 (14)–(15) 定义其概率与归一化完成比例。

blocks.original_text: The target progress bin yi and the loss are Eq. (16)... rather than planning long-horizon behavior.
blocks.translation: 进度头仅是训练辅助目标，鼓励粗粒度进度编码，不参与推理决策或长程规划。

blocks.original_text: To discourage bank collapse... complete objective is Eq. (19).
blocks.translation: 通过有效槽位均值的平方余弦相似度抑制记忆库塌缩；总目标结合视频、动作、多样性和进度损失。

blocks.original_text: We evaluate temporally dependent long-horizon tasks in simulation and on real-world robots... distinct behaviors.
blocks.translation: 作者在仿真和真实机器人上评估 DHEM 与进度监督，并研究记忆库是否产生不同行为。

blocks.original_text: DiM-WAM extends LingBot-VA... relevant historical event.
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 基于 LingBot-VA；RMBench 包含依赖少数关键历史和跨步骤历史的任务。

blocks.original_text: Table I audits whether camera views and temporal coverage expose the initial location... residual leakage in other tasks cannot be ruled out.
blocks.translation: 协议审计发现腕部视角可能泄漏窗口外的初始状态，故使用头部+前方视角、30 帧和步幅 1；其他任务仍可能有残余泄漏。

blocks.original_text: Following the protocol audit... additional protocol-matched in-house WAM baseline.
blocks.translation: 三种内部 WAM 遵循统一审计协议；仅 LingBot-VA 对 DiM-WAM 是训练匹配、可归因的受控比较。

blocks.original_text: DiM-WAM uses AdamW with learning rate 10^-5... comparisons are not compute matched.
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 使用 AdamW 和 8 个 12 槽位库；各任务模型在 8 张 H800 上训练，比较不算力匹配。

blocks.original_text: Real-robot experiments use one third-person camera... one binary gripper state.
blocks.translation: 真实实验使用一台第三人称相机；所有方法输出七个绝对关节位置和一个二值夹爪状态。

blocks.original_text: Among the in-house WAMs... supports attribution to the proposed memory design.
blocks.translation: 在内部 WAM 中，只有训练匹配 LingBot-VA 对 DiM-WAM 的对照能支持归因到记忆设计。

blocks.original_text: DiM-WAM achieves the highest reported success rate... M(n) (35.5% to 56.3%).
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 在九项中八项最高；训练匹配比较平均成功率从 34.8% 升至 69.8%。

blocks.original_text: We use four multi-stage Franka Panda tasks... averages in percent.
blocks.translation: 四项 Franka Panda 多阶段任务使用同组演示训练、十次完整试验评估，并报告 SSR 和 SR。

blocks.original_text: DiM-WAM raises the average SSR from 70.6% to 93.5%... task failure.
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 提升真实平均 SSR/SR；基线的共享失败模式是在相似局部观测下混淆进度。

blocks.original_text: Press Twice is included for completeness but exhibits a ceiling effect... real-world results are point estimates.
blocks.translation: Press Twice 有局部窗口覆盖约 85% 的天花板效应，不构成记忆特定优势证据；十次试验仅提供点估计。

blocks.original_text: Table IV ablates bank structure and progress supervision on Swap T and Swap Blocks.
blocks.translation: Table IV 在两项任务上消融记忆库结构和进度监督。

blocks.original_text: At a fixed total capacity of 32 slots... reduces the average to 90.5%.
blocks.translation: 固定总容量时多库提升性能；更大配置进一步提升但同时改变库数与容量；移除进度头使性能下降。

blocks.original_text: Fig. 6 qualitatively illustrates the retained events and event-token distributions in one successful put_back_block episode.
blocks.translation: Fig. 6 定性展示一次成功回合的保留事件和 token 分布。

blocks.original_text: The visualization is consistent with, but does not by itself establish, complementary cross-bank behavior... do not establish a general trend.
blocks.translation: 可视化与跨库互补一致，但并不能单独确立它；不同位置、过渡质量和重叠 PCA 仅是单回合观察。

blocks.original_text: DiM-WAM is a memory-augmented WAM with DHEM... memory-dependent tasks.
blocks.translation: DiM-WAM 是用于长时程操作的 DHEM 增强 WAM，在四项真实记忆依赖任务上平均完整成功率 90.0%。

blocks.original_text: Limitations and future work. DHEM is evaluated primarily... broader real-world evaluations.
blocks.translation: DHEM 的泛化、组件独立作用、粗进度代理可靠性和跨库稳定语义专化仍待验证。
